summary: Frontend implements a multi-section marketing homepage with anchor navigation and an inquiry form wired via a React Query mutation to a backend submit method. However, backend inquiry storage does not meet the spec (missing timestamp, stable upgrade persistence, and most-recent-first listing), SEO metadata changes are not evidenced, and required generated service icons are not used (lucide icons are used instead). Backend also adds unrelated user profile/access-control features not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement backend storage for contact/inquiry submissions with timestamp, list inquiries (most recent first), and persist data across canister upgrades using stable storage patterns.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend Inquiry type contains only {name, email, message} with no timestamp; inquiries are stored in an in-memory List without any stable storage/upgrade hooks; list ordering is not shown as most-recent-first (and List.values().toArray() does not demonstrate reverse order).

missing_requirements.requirement: Add basic SEO and metadata: page title, meta description, and Open Graph tags for the homepage.
missing_requirements.reason: No diff evidence shows changes/additions to HTML head metadata (e.g., index.html, Helmet usage, or equivalent). Only App/layout/components and CSS are shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Use the generated service icons (broom, spray bottle, mop, bucket) from frontend/public/assets/generated in the Services section (or feature cards).
missing_requirements.reason: Services section uses lucide-react icons (Home, Building2, Sparkles, Package) rather than referencing generated icon assets under /assets/generated/cleaning-icons-set.dim_512x512.png or individual icons derived from it.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile storage and access-controlled profile APIs (getCallerUserProfile, getUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile) plus authorization mixin initialization.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest is a marketing + contact site and only requests inquiry submission storage/listing; it explicitly lists third-party auth as a non-goal and does not request user profiles or authorization systems beyond what is needed for inquiry review.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin-token-based access-control initialization on actor creation in the frontend hook.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest; the site does not require authentication/authorization features for the marketing/contact flow.
